pull_requests.title: C061: measure reader setup and reject isolated axial reuse
pull_requests.body:
## Why

P11 and L03 still exceed the unchanged 100,000 shared-operation budget. C060 identified a large independent-reader setup interval but could not assign its generic checkpoint charges to the proposed axial-ancestry reuse path. This bounded follow-up measures that hypothesis before changing runtime behavior.

## Changes

- Add a separate bounded setup collector and an independent standard-library auditor that preserves all C060 input, command, work, exception and retained-byte checks.
- Publish the four original control/capture requests, both successful evidence audits, two deliberately corrupted evidence inputs and their expected rejections, exact partial source bytes, and independent reviews.
- Record a finite NO-GO. P11 executes no axial setup work; L03 executes four calls totaling 376 inclusive operations. Conditional on exact setup outputs and unchanged downstream paths/charges/cache effects, even free removal leaves a conservative lower bound of 100,218 operations.
- Preserve preparation failures, authentic recovery of 108 historical directory files, and the remaining twelve unavailable historical archive payloads. Propose a separate source-only ancestry-descriptor screen; it is not started.

## Actual verification

Executed commit: `bd5a09618c123a0b1d3339df3a944cfd6ed63b56`, tree `037157a58442ba1956597d32e1e540802f9ed896`.

| Check | Actual result |
| --- | --- |
| P11 control / capture | Both exit 1 at shared tick 100,001; 37 of 52 keys entered |
| L03 control / capture | Both exit 1 at shared tick 100,001; 154 of 178 keys entered |
| Independent pair audits | Both exit 0; 381,009 / 677,251 assertions |
| Two offline corruption controls | Both reject for their intended reasons; original inputs restored exactly |
| Local and remote evidence archive verification | Passed: 10 parts, 609 members, all 491 materialized source files and exact Git tree/commit |
| Payload readback | Passed: 39 files / 9,450,236 bytes at `84afc6ea32b8c0850d483e1c54fe31b33ce47e85` |
| Unchanged documentation gate | Exit 1: twelve historical archive targets unavailable; initial 17-link failure also retained |

## Dependency and limits

This draft is stacked on the explicit unmerged C060 dependency, draft PR #58, so its diff isolates C061. C060 head is `00533b953ed345cbf5fa13eaa56aafa3a2f052a8`; main remains `b37b39102aea67eb81bd9e38518352403a844e99`. No main lease or integration is claimed. Resolve and verify C060 before merging or retargeting this PR.

The executed source is a verified partial checkout: 491 materialized files and 2,890 explicit omissions. All 65 runtime files remain unchanged. No runtime candidate or conditional second request round was selected. No full corpus/unit suite/destination/visual gate was rerun, and no retained GLB is accepted. Historical 24/28 status, the four unresolved recordings, rejected M1, held C035 and unexecuted LFS migration remain unchanged.

Read `docs/engineering/reach-recording-validation-2026-10-28-c061/README.md`, `CHECKPOINT-061.md`, `HANDOFF-061.md`, `NEXT-TASK.md`, and the exact publication/gate receipts. No hosted or paid job was run.

pull_requests.title: C060: add original P11/L03 work diagnostics and audited evidence
pull_requests.body:
## Problem and result

The original P11 and L03 reach recordings still exceed the adopted 100,000-operation allowance. Selecting another numerical optimization requires an exact account of construction, production, independent-reader setup, and the key prefix actually reached.

This PR adds a reproducible original-request probe, passive stage/key collector, and independent standard-library auditor. Four serial product calls reproduce the original resource refusals. Their paired evidence agrees on complete counters, source inputs, limits, retained bytes, and underlying exception paths. The resulting ledger rules out isolated shortening of the producer's 239-denominator pi recurrence as the sole repair and defines the next bounded investigation into repeated axial ancestry work during reader setup.

**This is a draft diagnostic increment. P11/L03 remain failed, and the documentation gate is blocked by 12 unavailable historical archive payloads in this executor.** It changes none of the 65 product runtime files, numerical limits, source fixtures, numerical derivations, held C035 changes, M1 disposition, workflows, or shared STATUS.

## Changes

- Add `tools/probe_reach_recording_work.py`, `tools/capture_reach_recording_work.py`, and `tools/audit_reach_recording_work.py`.
- Retain exact raw request/audit evidence, all observed failures, four deliberate rejection probes, independent reviews, and the 488 executed inputs.
- Publish readable work ledgers, command receipts, source manifests, failure analyses, a handoff and a proposed C061 task; add one documentation-guide entry.
- Store the new evidence as nine ordinary Git payload parts, with ordered part/member manifests. Existing LFS configuration and migration status are unchanged.

## Actual measurements

Shared counts include the refused attempted tick at 100,001; no Reach category is fabricated for that tick.

| Measure | P11 | L03 |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Construction | 7,391 | 4,499 |
| Producer after construction | 54,024 | 50,489 |
| Reader initialization before first key | 23,171 | 17,185 |
| Entered-key calls, including partial failed key | 10,286 | 19,498 |
| Work between entered keys | 5,129 | 8,330 |
| Total attempted shared work | 100,001 | 100,001 |
| Entered keys / supplied keys | 37 / 52 | 154 / 178 |
| Wholly unvisited keys | 15 | 24 |

The isolated producer pi shortcut offers zero saving for P11 and at most 108 removed charges for L03 under the reviewed unchanged-output/path conditions. L03's wholly unvisited keys alone need at least 144 existing key-pose charges. This rejects that isolated candidate; it does not estimate complete tail cost or reject broader algorithms.

## Verification and exact attribution

- Product execution: commit `5170bb99bfb045c651e1aabb1ac5f24c9d2259dc`, tree `ed848bced2c9f8cf4027ffd278b6bf9e0be606e6`, CPython 3.12.14. All four processes actually returned **1**, preserving `OKL-E-RESOURCE` and the original settings.
- Execution-time input scope: **488 / 3,329 tracked files**, 9,364,004 verified bytes, all 65 runtime files, and 2,841 explicit omissions. Full Git tree identity and exact commit object verified. This was a separately named partial-checkout diagnostic, not the stock whole-checkout harness.
- Two initial and two final offline audits passed. The three initial tamper checks rejected changed work counts, GLB bytes, and input manifests; the final auditor also rejected a changed executable. Tests are attributed to their respective auditor hashes.
- The final auditor is 71,385 bytes, SHA-256 `5a1ece268ba6f8bf71f2f62fbe2963da34175280797ec66be668261b2886b0cf`.
- Independent source/provenance, diagnostic/optimization-screen, auditor, and final-publication reviews found no blocker for the stated diagnostic scope.
- The unchanged documentation checker returned **1**: all 29 preserved sources, 233 sections and exact registry rows verified; 275 documents and 2,055 local links checked; exactly the same 12 missing historical archive targets as the clean baseline. Their remote-tree sizes total 74,915,834 bytes. No placeholder or relaxed check was used.
- Retrieved **all 50 changed files** at publication commit `73596821b6c4154a848202ab04583b717a9c0032` and independently verified their actual lengths, SHA-256 and Git blob identities. Reassembled the nine remotely retrieved parts and verified every one of the 603 ZIP members. ZIP: 6,962,230 bytes, SHA-256 `0865d06b6aee8290ebcd9372218f5c2b784a1b97bfcffc249b2fced3bdc81df5`.
- Final head `00533b953ed345cbf5fa13eaa56aafa3a2f052a8` adds only that readback receipt. Its tree is `c608ea92070266edc3980ea0bbf2968e32422f94`; all 275 checked documentation inputs remain byte-identical.

No full regression suite, new original28 run, Agent delivery, compatibility matrix, browser/native/visual gate, hosted workflow or release acceptance was executed or claimed. Retained GLBs remain unvalidated reader inputs. No timing neutrality, speedup, complete-request saving, or unexecuted-tail cost is claimed. Historical original28 remains 24/28, with P11/P16/P23/L03 unresolved.

## Review and continuation

- [Engineering record](https://github.com/Omegapy/OntoKin/blob/00533b953ed345cbf5fa13eaa56aafa3a2f052a8/docs/engineering/reach-recording-validation-2026-10-28-c060/README.md)
- [Handoff](https://github.com/Omegapy/OntoKin/blob/00533b953ed345cbf5fa13eaa56aafa3a2f052a8/docs/engineering/reach-recording-validation-2026-10-28-c060/HANDOFF.md)
- [Measured next task](https://github.com/Omegapy/OntoKin/blob/00533b953ed345cbf5fa13eaa56aafa3a2f052a8/docs/engineering/reach-recording-validation-2026-10-28-c060/NEXT-TASK.md)
- [Remote publication verification](https://github.com/Omegapy/OntoKin/blob/00533b953ed345cbf5fa13eaa56aafa3a2f052a8/docs/engineering/reach-recording-validation-2026-10-28-c060/publication-readback.json)

Hydrate the complete repository in an authenticated executor and pass the unchanged preservation/navigation checker before integration. Reconcile actual heads and acquire a fresh bounded main lease under OK-ENG-009. This scope did not acquire a main lease or change main; product execution is complete and the exclusive execution window is released. C061 is proposed, not running or scheduled.

Related coordination: #26. The existing owner mandate covers routine continuation; no new permission request is needed for authorized branch work.

## C061 COMPLETE — scope and exclusive finalization window released

Owner `interactive-reach-reader-setup-20261028-c061-7of9-b4f2` releases C061 scope and window 6483443929 at observed 2026-10-28 23:40:47 UTC. Product window 6483222304 was previously released in 6483342626. All product, audit, documentation, archive, verification and publication processes have finished. All three assisting workers are paused. No C062 worker, schedule or background job was started; no main integration lease was acquired.

### Published, verified checkpoint

- Draft PR #59: https://github.com/Omegapy/OntoKin/pull/59, stacked on the explicit unmerged C060 draft PR #58.
- Final C061 head `e5e99b92e4efa541b434abcdda5c2ec31dda6a39`; tree `fb17897b2de27b79cf1b9aa790c7c354e17855d3`.

- Payload commit `84afc6ea32b8c0850d483e1c54fe31b33ce47e85`: all 39 files / 9,450,236 bytes fetched back and byte/Git-blob verified. All eight successor receipt files and both diagnostic tools were then read back at the final head. Ten archive parts reassemble to the verified 609-member measurement archive.
- Main remains `b37b39102aea67eb81bd9e38518352403a844e99`; C060 remains `00533b953ed345cbf5fa13eaa56aafa3a2f052a8`; archive-only branch remains `e6917dae0be3a786c22e76be3de62e3c97784cf5`. No merge or workflow change occurred.

### Finite decision and actual checks

NO-GO for isolated axial reader-setup reuse. Exactly four original requests ran. P11 control/capture and L03 control/capture all exit 1 at attempted shared tick 100,001. Both pair audits pass (381,009 / 677,251 assertions); both offline corruption probes reject for the intended reasons and restore exact original inputs. P11 performs no axial setup calls; L03 performs four totaling 376 inclusive operations. Independent review confirms the conditional lower bound `100000 - 376 + 144 + 450 = 100218` when exact setup outputs and downstream charged paths/cache behavior are preserved. No runtime candidate or conditional second request round was selected. No complete-request saving or accepted recording is claimed.

The final unchanged documentation gate exits 1 on twelve unavailable historical archive payloads (74,915,834 bytes). Its initial 17-link failure is preserved; all 108 authentic files in four omitted historical directories were recovered, resolving five directory links. No placeholders, preservation rewrites or LFS pointers were substituted. Historical 24/28 status and P11/P16/P23/L03 release failures remain; no full suite/corpus/destination/visual gate was rerun. M1 remains rejected, C035 held, LFS migration unexecuted, hosted execution unused.

### Portable handoff and next action

`OntoKin_C061_Handoff_2026-10-28.zip`: 9,962,352 bytes; SHA-256 `72206f965330af89ffc681edcd2908ddc4e5a4d68245b729c302f554f2962bc9`. Local verification passed for all 551 packet members, final Git tree/commit, 537 included repository paths / 2,890 explicit omissions, and the nested measurement archive. Start with README-START-HERE.md. This is a portable partial checkout, not a full clone.

Recover the twelve exact historical payloads through a working authorized byte route and pass the unchanged documentation gate before integration. Resolve C060 dependency order against live heads. C061 NEXT-TASK proposes a separate static authority/cost screen for ordered source ancestry descriptors inside _phase -> _ancestry; it is not active and does not reopen the rejected axial route or automatically authorize another tuning loop. Reconcile current refs and this coordination thread before activating a new bounded scope.
